definitions.gloss: tight-lipped, discreet, able to keep secrets
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who can be trusted with confidential information and won't reveal it to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}が{堅|かた}い⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She can keep a secret, so I feel safe.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}の{堅|かた}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦{話|はな}せない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I can only tell this to someone who can keep a secret.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秘書|ひしょ}→秘書：05502_hisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}が{堅|かた}く⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。

{口|くち}が{堅|かた}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Once people realized I was discreet, everyone started coming to me for advice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}が{堅|かた}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任|まか}されて→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's tight-lipped, so he's entrusted with important company information.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{堅|かた}い→堅い：18753_katai⟧ (hard/firm). Literally 'one's mouth is firm' - implying words don't escape easily.

ANTONYM: ⟦{口|くち}が{軽|かる}い→口が軽い：06884_kuchigakarui⟧ (loose-lipped, indiscreet)

PRENOMINAL FORM: {口|くち}の{堅|かた}い + noun (a discreet [person])

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to keep a secret)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (trustworthy)

CULTURAL NOTE: Being {口|くち}が{堅|かた}い is considered a valuable trait in Japanese business and personal relationships.
